summary:
ASTRA-FIRE AI: Advancing Fire Safety Beyond Earth

ASTRA-FIRE AI is an AI-powered scientific research platform designed to support the study of combustion and fire safety in space environments.

Our team developed an interactive dashboard that integrates a scientific library of 190 research documents, an AI research assistant powered by Google Gemini, scientific data exploration tools, and an evidence-based fire hazard assessment module.

The platform addresses the challenge of understanding fire behavior in microgravity, where combustion differs significantly from conditions on Earth. By organizing scientific research and making it accessible through artificial intelligence, ASTRA-FIRE AI helps users explore experimental findings, identify relevant studies, interpret scientific information, and evaluate documented combustion hazards.

This project is important because fire safety is essential for protecting astronauts, spacecraft, and future long-duration space missions. ASTRA-FIRE AI aims to bridge the gap between complex scientific research and accessible, evidence-informed decision support, contributing to safer and more sustainable human exploration beyond Earth.
details:
Project Details – ASTRA-FIRE AI 🔥🚀

ASTRA-FIRE AI is an AI-powered scientific research platform designed to make information about fire science, combustion, and fire management more accessible, organized, and easier to explore.

Our project addresses a common challenge faced by students and researchers: scientific information is often scattered across multiple websites, databases, and publications, making it difficult and time-consuming to find relevant and reliable sources.

ASTRA-FIRE AI brings together more than 180 specialized scientific resources, including research papers, experimental reports, and technical documents from organizations such as NASA and other scientific institutions.

How does it work?

The platform features an interactive dashboard where users can:

  • Explore scientific research: Access a centralized collection of studies related to combustion, fire behavior, microgravity experiments, and fire management.
  • Search and filter information: Find relevant documents through thematic categories and research classifications.
  • Upload research documents: Submit PDF files for AI-assisted analysis and classification without automatically adding them to the official database.
  • Use an AI research assistant: Receive guidance to better understand scientific documents and explore related research topics.
  • Access original sources: Follow direct links to scientific publications for further investigation.

Technologies Used

ASTRA-FIRE AI was developed using:

  • Python: Main programming language.
  • Streamlit: Interactive web dashboard and user interface.
  • Google Gemini API: AI-assisted document interpretation and classification.
  • SQLite and CSV: Structured research information management.
  • Google Drive and Google Sheets: Scientific document organization and inventory management.
  • Visual Studio Code: Software development environment.

Innovation and Creativity

What makes ASTRA-FIRE AI unique is its specialized approach to scientific information discovery.

Unlike general-purpose search engines or AI chatbots, our platform focuses on a curated collection of fire-related scientific resources, combining structured research classifications, document exploration, and AI-assisted consultation in one accessible environment.

Rather than replacing researchers or generating complex scientific predictions, ASTRA-FIRE AI helps users discover relevant studies, understand their context, and access original scientific evidence more efficiently.

Intended Impact

Our goal is to reduce the barriers to scientific research, especially for students, educators, and emerging researchers who may not know where to begin exploring specialized topics.

By improving access to research on combustion, including experiments conducted in microgravity, ASTRA-FIRE AI aims to support scientific learning, encourage interdisciplinary exploration, and contribute to a better understanding of fire-related phenomena.

Key Considerations

Throughout development, our team prioritized scientific credibility, accessibility, ease of use, transparent access to original sources, and responsible integration of artificial intelligence.

ASTRA-FIRE AI does not aim to replace scientific expertise. It aims to make scientific knowledge easier to discover, navigate, and understand.

Our vision is simple: Making fire science research more accessible through artificial intelligence.
